<section class="st-hero"><p class="st-kicker">Research dissemination</p><h2>Ideas, methods and applications</h2><p>A selection of my workshop talks, conference presentations and research proposal pitches, spanning near-field communications and sensing, mathematical signal processing and goal-oriented massive connectivity. Click a slide preview or PDF link to explore the complete presentation.</p></section>
<h2 class="st-section">Award-winning research proposal</h2>
<article class="st-card st-featured" id="good-sense">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/GOOD_SENSE_GLOBECOM_2025.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open slides for GOOD SENSE"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="GOOD SENSE title slide with a red shoe on a dark blue background" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Award-winning industry research proposal</p><p class="st-event">IEEE GLOBECOM 2025</p><span class="st-award">&#127942; IEEE GLOBECOM 2025 Best Proposal for Industry Research Collaboration</span><h3>GOOD SENSE</h3><p class="st-subtitle">Goal-Oriented Detection and Sensing Enabler</p><p class="st-desc"><strong>Reliable 6G Connectivity and Comprehensive Perception at Scale.</strong> A proposal for scalable integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), designed to reduce the dependence of detection resources on the number of inactive devices. The pitch uses the Cinderella search analogy to explain goal-oriented detection and motivates receiver co-design and testing with industry partners.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/GOOD_SENSE_GLOBECOM_2025.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">6 slides &middot; 4.1 MB</span></div></div>
</article>
<h2 class="st-section">Workshop, conference and research presentations</h2>
<div class="st-grid"><article class="st-card" id="offgrid-demixing">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Off_Grid_Blind_Deconvolution_and_Demixing.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open slides for Timely and Painless Breakups: Off-the-grid Blind Deconvolution and Demixing"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Simulation results: dual polynomial peaks, waveform estimates and recovered continuous parameters" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Research presentation</p><p class="st-event">26 November 2026 · Date on slides</p><h3>Timely and Painless Breakups</h3><p class="st-subtitle">Off-the-grid Blind Deconvolution and Demixing</p><p class="st-desc">Recovering sparse continuous signals and unknown point-spread functions from mixed convolution measurements. The talk develops lifting, atomic-norm minimization, semidefinite programming, dual certificates and sample-complexity guarantees, with applications in ISAC, super-resolution microscopy, neural spike sorting and DNA sequencing.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Off_Grid_Blind_Deconvolution_and_Demixing.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TIT.2025.3566885">Related paper &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">21 slides &middot; 3.2 MB</span></div></div>
</article>
<article class="st-card" id="nearfield-workshop">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Near_Field_Workshop_Kista_2026.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open slides for When Near Becomes Super Far: From Rayleigh to Optimal Near/Far-Field Boundaries"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Slide comparing the spherical-wave near-field and planar-wave far-field channel models" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Workshop talk</p><p class="st-event">Workshop on Near-field Communications and Sensing · Kista, Sweden · 26 November 2026</p><h3>When Near Becomes Super Far</h3><p class="st-subtitle">From Rayleigh to Optimal Near/Far-Field Boundaries</p><p class="st-desc">From the classical Rayleigh distance to application-driven near/far-field boundaries. The talk examines spherical and planar channel models, mismatch metrics, spectral efficiency and model-based estimation, with implications for hardware, signal processing and network design.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Near_Field_Workshop_Kista_2026.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07743">Related paper &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">14 slides &middot; 0.7 MB</span></div></div>
</article><article class="st-card" id="globecom-2025">
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Conference presentation</p><p class="st-event">IEEE GLOBECOM 2025</p><h3><a class="st-title-link" href="{{ '/near-field-animations/' | relative_url }}">When Near Becomes Far</a></h3><p class="st-subtitle">From Rayleigh to Optimal Near/Far-Field Boundaries</p><figure class="st-animation-preview">

</figure><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/near-field-animations/' | relative_url }}">Watch both animations &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/GLOBECOM_2025_Near_Far_Field.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07743">Related paper &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">14 slides &middot; 1.3 MB</span></div></div>
</article><article class="st-card" id="collaborative-isac">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Collaborative_Uplink_ISAC_WiOpt_2025.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open slides for One target, many views"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="One Target, Many Views: a conceptual illustration of multiple sensing viewpoints around a single target." loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Workshop presentation</p><p class="st-event">WiOpt 2025 · ISAC Workshop</p><h3>One target, many views</h3><p class="st-desc">A collaborative uplink ISAC framework that jointly recovers user messages and continuous delay, Doppler and angle parameters using three-dimensional atomic norms. The presentation discusses shared-target identification, multi-user fusion and numerical improvements in localization and symbol recovery.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/Collaborative_Uplink_ISAC_WiOpt_2025.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="https://doi.org/10.23919/WiOpt66569.2025.11123413">Related paper &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">12 slides &middot; 1.3 MB</span></div></div>
</article>
<article class="st-card" id="bagod">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/BaGOD_WiOpt_2023.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open slides for Blind Asynchronous Goal-Oriented Detection (BaGOD) for Massive Connectivity"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="BaGOD goal-oriented optimization and dual-polynomial spectrum" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Conference slides</p><p class="st-event">WiOpt 2023 · Singapore</p><h3>BaGOD</h3><p class="st-subtitle">Blind Asynchronous Goal-Oriented Detection for Massive Connectivity</p><p class="st-desc">A reconstruction-free optimization strategy for active-user detection with asynchronous transmissions. The presentation covers angular sparsity, goal-oriented dual polynomials, delay-gain estimation and numerical comparisons.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/BaGOD_WiOpt_2023.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">16 slides &middot; 1.8 MB</span></div></div>
</article><article class="st-card" id="bgod">
<a class="st-image" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/BGOD_Massive_Access.pdf' | relative_url }}" aria-label="Open BGOOD slides: Blind Goal-Oriented Detection for massive access"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Semidefinite optimization and goal-oriented dual polynomial from the original BGOD slides" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>
<div class="st-content"><p class="st-kicker">Research presentation</p><p class="st-event">20 October 2022 · Date on slides</p><h3>BGOOD</h3><p class="st-subtitle">Blind Goal-Oriented Detection <span style="font-weight:400">(pronounced &ldquo;Be GOOD&rdquo;)</span></p><p class="st-desc">A mathematical approach to extracting the information needed for active-user detection without reconstructing all devices’ signals. The slides discuss atomic norms, dual polynomials, numerical performance and possible applications beyond wireless communications.</p><div class="st-actions"><a class="st-button" href="{{ '/assets/pdf/BGOD_Massive_Access.pdf' | relative_url }}">View slides (PDF) &rarr;</a><a class="st-paper" href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TSP.2023.3254140">Related paper &rarr;</a><span class="st-meta">27 slides &middot; 1.2 MB</span></div></div>
</article></div>
